name: @sharedid-edge/module-gpp
description: SharedID Edge module (opt-in): storage consent from the US sections of an IAB GPP string (US National and the state sections): an opt-out of sale, sharing or targeted advertising denies the SharedID

sharedidEdge.name: gpp
sharedidEdge.title: US opt-outs from the GPP string
sharedidEdge.summary: Nothing in the payload: a consent provider that decodes the US National and US state sections of the `gpp` string that `gpp_sid` names. An opt-out of sale, sharing or targeted advertising, or a known child without consent, denies the SharedID and deletes it, like GPC; a string it can't read for those sections denies too
